entry.title: rethinking zero-click search
entry.content:
A quick write-up on zero-click search, mostly so future me stops relearning it.

why it matters

Zero-click search shows up across seo work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Prefer the obvious solution; clever costs interest forever.
  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.
  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
